name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace
description: Spec-Driven Development agents, engineering skills and reviewers for Claude Code. Project-agnostic; configured per repository via .claude/sdd.json.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Paved-path engineering skills: React, Next.js, Fastify, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Zod, testing, security, architecture and Mermaid diagrams.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only researcher agent that answers questions about a codebase or the web with an evidence-backed, structured report.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Read-only architecture reviewer agent that checks a change set against layering and placement rules and returns a verdict with file:line findings.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
